decisions.topic: Length3=0 is an actual processor obligation
decisions.source: §9.9.1 Table125 physical368/printed353 says explicit Length3 0 means 512 zeros and cleartomark were not included and shall be added by the processor; NOTE2 physical369/printed354 describes the fixed portion.
decisions.current: with_fixed_content appends only for resolved integer zero. A direct unit test asserts exact count/operator, and the public PaintType integration’s valid generated Type1 uses Length3=0 and successfully loads/draws a nonempty outline. Ledger 9.9.1 is implemented and cites both the direct tests.
decisions.verdict: Implemented; no additional test warranted. Do not claim that missing or positive but inconsistent Length3 triggers any ISO-mandated reader response.

decisions.source: Length1/2/3 describe decoded byte extents; §7.3.8 stream filters are applied before the lengths are meaningful.
decisions.current: stated_extent is consulted for Truncated and CheckValue filter-damage handling, with the complete program parser otherwise reading bytes. Type1 uses sum; FontFile2 uses Length1; FontFile3 CFF has no such lengths under the following §9.9.1 text.
decisions.verdict: Selected logic agrees with the effective text; no claim that producer fields require a reader to reject invalid data.

decisions.source: Table125 requires a FontFile3 Subtype name. Separate §14.3.2 Table348 NOTE1 says embedded-font-file metadata should be attached to its stream.
decisions.current: The byte signature selects parser route, tolerating erroneous Subtype. Xmp::read is generic; existing Form XObject test covers component metadata but font loading does not expose XMP.
decisions.verdict: No valid-input gap or specific reader duty identified. Producer requirement and generic metadata placement are not font-decoding mandates.

decisions.source: ADR0040 predates stated_extent; ADR0475 records Length1/2/3 use and then still calls Length3=0 execution pending.
decisions.current: Current code has with_fixed_content; 9.9.1 ledger is implemented and names passing direct and public consumer assertions.
decisions.verdict: Treat the “not executed/still not executed” passages as historical stale notes, not current ledger or runtime failure.
